snippet.title: Hometown — Stories Played Together | Official Brand Launch Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
📚 Read the full story behind the game:
https://medium.com/@christianjbotella/https-www-hometowngames-app-the-game-that-put-families-back-together-php-d3c6853288b1

🌐 Visit us: https://www.hometowngames.app

There is a question that sits quietly at the centre
of almost every family in America right now.

When was the last time everyone in your family
was in the same room, looking at the same thing,
and no one wanted to be anywhere else?

Hometown is built for that moment.

It is a two-player city-building game for grandparents
and grandchildren, parents and children.
One person plans. One person explores.
Neither can build it alone.

✔  No ads. No timers. No competition.
✔  Works offline via Bluetooth.
✔  Designed for families to play side by side.
✔  Free on iOS and Android.

Read the full story behind the game:
https://www.hometowngames.app
